title: Best Full Length Mirror (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Picks were based on mentions in PCMag, CNET, Tom’s Guide, OneClearWinner and Architectural Digest.

verdict.line: Buy the Mirror if you want live and on‑demand workout classes in a slim, space‑saving design. It streams classes for $39 a month after a $1,495 upfront cost, but it won’t work with third‑party fitness apps.
